What is Tally and how does it compare to Typeform?

Tally is a modern online form builder that functions much like a Notion document. Unlike Typeform, which charges based on monthly response limits, Tally provides unlimited forms and unlimited submissions on its free tier.

Key differences include:

  • Pricing: Tally is significantly more affordable with 99% features free.
  • Interface: Tally uses slash-commands, while Typeform uses card-by-card steps.

Learn more at Tally Forms or compare with Typeform.
